components.note: 日 (sun) — three suns make something brilliantly bright, a crystal; also in 明 bright, 晴 sunny.
⺼ (flesh, 肉月旁) — body parts, as in 脸 face, 肝 liver; 脉 is the network of vessels branching through the body.
扌 (hand) — striking and grappling; also in 打 hit, 抱 hold.
尃 (fū) is a loose clue; it also sounds out 博 bó, 簿 bù and 薄 báo.
壴 (drum) — a festive drum, hence joyful and excellent; the top of 鼓 gǔ drum.
加 (jiā) gives the exact sound; it also sounds out 架 jià, 驾 jià and 贺 hè.
糸 (silk, simplified 纟) — dyed cloth, hence colours; also in 红 red, 绿 green.
此 (cǐ) gives a close sound; it also sounds out 柴 chái and 雌 cí.
风 (fēng, wind) — in the oldest writing the phoenix and the wind shared one character, hence the similar look and sound (fèng / fēng).
皇 (huáng) gives the exact sound; it also sounds out 煌 huáng, 惶 huáng and 蝗 huáng.
羊 — a sheep's head with curved horns; the sheep radical, as in 美 beautiful, 群 flock. It also sounds out 样 yàng and 养 yǎng.
目 (eye) — looking at something; also in 看 look, 眼 eye.
者 (zhě) is a loose clue; 赌 dǔ and 堵 dǔ share it and sound exactly like 睹.
尚 (shàng) gives the rhyme; 党 is a simplification of 黨, which was 尚 over 黑.
雨 (rain) — scattered raindrops, hence small bits and nothing; also in 雪 snow, 雷 thunder.
令 (lìng) gives a close sound; it also sounds out 铃 líng, 龄 líng and 领 lǐng.
力 (strength) — hard-won merit; also in 努 strive, 动 move. The traditional 勳 had 熏 xūn for the sound; 员 is only a stand-in.
日 (sun) — the sun sinking into the grass: dusk (the original of 暮 mù); later borrowed for "no, do not". 莫 also sounds out 墓 mù, 幕 mù and 摸 mō.
扌 (hand) — shaking by hand; also in 摇 shake, 拍 pat.
斗 (dǒu) gives the exact sound.
先 (xiān) is only a loose clue; 宪 simplifies the traditional 憲.
疋 (foot, 足 variant) — clearing a channel so it flows; 疏 also sounds out 蔬 shū.
幺 (a tiny thread) — small and slight, as in 幻, 幽.
力 (strength) — little strength: the young; also in 努 strive, 动 move.
禾 (grain) — young crops, hence childlike; also in 种 plant, 秋 autumn.
隹 (zhuī) is a rough clue; it also appears in 谁, 难, 集.
止 (foot) — a path under the foot; 歧 is a fork in the road, as in 步 step, 走.
支 (zhī) is a loose clue; it also sounds out 枝 zhī, 肢 zhī and 岐 qí.
灬 (fire, 四点底) — flames below, as in 热 hot, 照 shine, 煮 cook.
前 (qián) gives a close sound; it also sounds out 剪 jiǎn.
贝 (shell, old money) — allowances and payments, as in 财 wealth, 买 buy.
占 (zhàn) is only a loose sound clue for tiē.
氵 (water) — harbours lie on water; also in 河 river, 海 sea.
巷 (xiàng) shares the rhyme -ang; only a loose sound clue.
忄 (heart) — pity in the heart; also in 怜 pity, 情 feeling.
闵 (mǐn) gives the exact sound.
日 (sun) — exposure to the sun; also in 晒 dry in the sun, 晴 sunny.
暴 (bào) gives the sound; it also sounds out 瀑 pù and 爆 bào.
扌 (hand) — hitting; also in 打 hit, 推 push.
童 (tóng) is only a loose sound clue for zhuàng.
土 (earth) — flat ground; also in 地 ground, 城 city.
平 (píng) gives the exact sound and the idea of flat; it also sounds out 评 píng and 苹 píng.
穴 (cave, hole) — cornered in a hole with no way out: exhausted, poor; also in 空 empty, 窗 window.
扌 (hand) — pressing down; also in 压 press, 按 push.
卬 (yǎng) is a loose clue; it also sounds out 仰 yǎng and 迎 yíng.
艹 (grass) — plants, the deep green of grass; also in 草 grass, 花 flower.
仓 (cāng) gives the exact sound; it also sounds out 沧 cāng and 舱 cāng.
虫 (insect) — creatures, as in 蚊 mosquito, 蛇 snake.
黾 (mǐn, toad) is only a loose sound clue for yíng.
⺼ (flesh, 肉月旁) — body parts, as in 脚 foot, 脸 face.
退 (tuì) gives the same syllable with a different tone.
木 (wood) — trees; 杜 first named a pear tree, as in 树 tree, 林 forest.
土 (tǔ) gives a close sound; it also sounds out 肚 dù.
火 (fire) — what is left after a fire dies down: ash; 灰 also sounds out 恢 huī.
扌 (hand) — twisting by hand; also in 拧 wring, 拉 pull.
丑 (chǒu) is a loose clue; 纽 niǔ and 钮 niǔ share it and sound exactly like 扭.
火 (fire) — roasting over flames; also in 烧 burn, 煮 cook.
考 (kǎo) gives the exact sound; it also sounds out 拷 kǎo and 铐 kào.
艹 (grass) — plants; 葱 is the onion, as in 草 grass, 菜 vegetable.
怱 (cōng) gives the exact sound; it also sounds out 聪 cōng and 匆 cōng.
钅 (metal, simplified 金) — the metal bit held in a horse's mouth, hence to hold in the mouth; 衔 is also a rank or title.
行 (xíng) gives a close sound for xián.
犭 (animal, 反犬旁) — beasts, as in 猫 cat, 狗 dog, 狼 wolf.
瓜 (guā) is a loose clue; it also sounds out 孤 gū and 弧 hú.
犭 (animal) — beasts, as in 猫 cat, 狗 dog.
里 (lǐ) gives the same syllable with a different tone; it also sounds out 理 lǐ and 埋 mái.
氵 (water radical, 三点水) — marks rivers, liquids and anything that flows, as in 海 sea, 汤 soup, 酒 liquor.
可 (kě) hints at the sound — 河 is hé; 可 also sounds out 歌 gē and 何 hé.
髟 (long hair) — the hair radical, as in 鬓 temples, 鬃 mane.
毛 (máo) gives the exact sound and the idea: 髦 is hair like a mane.
扌 (hand) — choosing by hand; also in 拿 take, 选 choose.
夬 (guài) is a loose clue; 决 jué shares it and sounds exactly like 抉.
足 (foot, ⻊) — foot parts, as in 脚 foot, 跑 run, 跳 jump.
果 (guǒ) is only a loose clue; it also sounds out 课 kè and 裸 luǒ.
口 (mouth) — talk; also in 叫 shout, 说 speak.
劳 (láo) gives the exact sound; it also sounds out 涝 lào and 捞 lāo.
口 (mouth) — nagging talk; also in 叫 shout, 说 speak.
刀 (dāo) gives the exact sound.
火 (fire) — dazzling light; also in 灯 lamp, 烧 burn.
玄 (xuán) gives a close sound; it also sounds out 眩 xuàn and 弦 xián.
巾 (cloth) — a scarf or handkerchief; also in 布 cloth, 帽 hat.
白 (bái) is a loose clue; 怕 pà shares it and sounds exactly like 帕.
艹 (grass) — plants; 芭 is the banana plant, as in 草 grass, 花 flower.
巴 (bā) gives the exact sound; it also sounds out 吧 ba, 爸 bà and 疤 bā.
艹 (grass) — plants; 蕾 is a flower bud, as in 花 flower, 草 grass.
雷 (léi) gives a close sound; it also sounds out 擂 léi and 镭 léi.
